svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', DejaVu Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Evolution — concept sheet 03: origins, the single-cell evolution ladder
svg.desc: Protocell → prokaryote → endosymbiosis → eukaryote → specialised forms, in the dark-field microscopy language of cell-sheet.svg. Code-drawn SVG: gradients, blur and turbulence filters, layered paths, zero raster. Palette constants in docs/concept-art/README.md.
svg.text: · concept sheet 03 — ORIGINS · the single-cell ladder
You start as a bare protocell and evolve inside one cell: protocell → prokaryote → endosymbiosis → eukaryote → specialised forms · dark-field language of sheet 01 · 1 wu = 1 px at zoom 1.0
ticket #114 · epic #2 · defines the level-1 look · DNA absorbed from prey unlocks each step
all shapes code-drawn: gradients, blur, turbulence · zero raster
r ≈ 10 wu · 10 px / wu · bilayer · 3–6 granules · no nucleus · drift + wobble
